framework: UIKit (Text display, fonts, TextKit, Writing Tools, handwriting)
summary: Attributed strings, a TextKit 2 style layout model, paragraph styles, lists, tables, attachments, a find bar model, spell checking and writing assistance models exist. A text formatting panel model and a coordinator that binds it to the focused rich text view exist in the SDK; the shell does not draw the panel yet. Content size categories and the SDK text view that joins these are missing. Handwriting input needs a stylus, which the tablet does not have.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: attributes, ranges and a rich editing model
pure model with storage, containers and fragments; no viewport layout controller
selection and navigation by granularity; logical, not visual, movement for bidirectional text
paragraph style fields and list markers
absolute, percentage and share column widths with spans
attachments take part in layout; no view-provider attachments and no adaptive image glyphs
typesetter, framesetter and line breaking with any font through a glyph source

features.apple: UIFont, UIFontDescriptor, UIFontMetrics, scaling fonts automatically
features.note: descriptor matching and a type scale; Ui::text_scale (0.85 to 1.3) scales every text size, but there are no content size categories and no per-style font metrics scaling, which touch UIs rely on for accessibility
vertical layout and bidi reordering models
word and sentence checks; no grammar checking type
wrapped text view model with caret and selection, and a shell-only touch editor. No SDK view that combines layout manager, editing, links and text item menus

built on parity/team-p-text-formatting; not yet verified on the tablet. The panel model (controls with active flags), the commands (marks, font, size, colour, alignment, lists) as undoable edits, and a coordinator bound to the focused text view. The panel is not drawn yet.
behaviour levels, context and a suggestion session as a model; no UI and no model backend wired
needs stylus (pen) input, which the tablet does not have; finger handwriting is not built
query, options, matches and counter as a model; no find panel view on the touch UI
popover model for definitions and quick search hits

gaps: Content size categories and per-style font metrics scaling on top of the global text scale
SDK text view that joins the layout manager, selection UI and text input client
Text formatting panel drawing on the touch UI and binding to the focused text view in the shell (the model is in springboard/sdk/src/text_formatting.rs)
